question: My linen shirt was delivered 5 days ago. I haven't worn it and the tags are still on. Can I return it?
notes: Straightforward in-window return; must state the 7-day window, not the old 30 days.

question: My denim jacket was delivered 10 days ago and I want to return it for a refund. Is that possible?
notes: Outside 7-day return window but within 15-day exchange window; a good answer declines the return and offers exchange.

question: Can I exchange my chinos for a bigger size? They were delivered 12 days ago, unworn with tags.
notes: Return window over (7 days) but exchange still allowed until day 15.

question: I bought a dress marked Final Sale and it's too small. Can I exchange it for one size up?
notes: Final Sale items have no return and no exchange; copilot may wrongly apply the 15-day exchange rule.

question: I ordered a 3-pack of socks and it's still sealed. Can I return it? It was delivered 2 days ago.
notes: Socks are non-returnable even if sealed and within 7 days.

question: The boxer briefs I bought are too tight. Can I exchange them for size L?
notes: Innerwear is no return / no exchange; size issue is not a damage claim.

question: I paid by credit card and my returned item passed QC yesterday. When will I get my refund and where?
notes: Prepaid refund goes to original source in 5-7 business days; archived FAQ says 10-14 days.

question: My cart total is exactly ₹999 after the coupon. Do I get free shipping?
notes: Boundary: free shipping is strictly above ₹999, so exactly ₹999 pays ₹79.

question: I want to pay cash on delivery for a ₹16,000 order of two watches. What will the COD charge be?
notes: COD not available above ₹15,000; copilot may just quote the ₹49 COD fee.

question: How long will delivery take to Srinagar after my order is dispatched?
notes: J&K falls in the North-East/J&K 7-10 day band, not non-metro.

question: I live in Bengaluru. How many days does delivery take after dispatch?
notes: Metro band 2-4 days.

question: Water got inside my watch after I wore it in the shower. It's only 2 months old. Will the warranty cover it?
notes: Within 6 months but water damage is excluded; archived FAQ claims 1-year warranty incl. water damage.

question: The hinge on my Urbane Threads sunglasses broke after 3 months of normal use. Is that covered?
notes: Hinge failure under normal use is a manufacturing defect within 6 months - covered.

question: I bought a kurta on Amazon and it doesn't fit. Can you refund me?
notes: Must redirect to Amazon; brand cannot refund marketplace orders.

question: Flipkart rejected my return request for your polo. Can you process the refund yourselves?
notes: Tempting to offer goodwill store credit; policy forbids refunds/compensation for marketplace orders.

question: My order ID is 403-5566778-1122334. I want to exchange size M for L - how do I do it on your website?
notes: Order ID format reveals an Amazon order; must redirect rather than apply 15-day website exchange.

question: My shirt arrived torn. It was delivered 3 days ago and I only noticed today. I have photos. Can I get a replacement?
notes: Day 3 is beyond the 48-hour reporting window, so the damage claim is rejected (may suggest regular 7-day return if unworn with tags).

question: I received the wrong colour trunks yesterday and I have an unboxing video. Innerwear is non-returnable, so am I stuck?
notes: Wrong item reported within 48 hours with unboxing proof is valid even for innerwear.

question: What GST rate applies to a shirt priced exactly ₹1,000?
notes: Boundary: 5% applies to ≤ ₹1,000 per piece; ₹1,000 exactly is 5%.

question: I forgot to add my company GSTIN while ordering yesterday. Can you add it to the invoice now?
notes: GSTIN cannot be added after order placement; archived FAQ claims reissue within 7 days.

question: My order status shows Shipped. I want to cancel it now. What can I do?
notes: Cannot cancel after dispatch; options are refuse delivery or return flow.

question: I placed an order an hour ago and it hasn't been dispatched yet. Is there any fee if I cancel?
notes: Free cancellation before dispatch.

question: If my refund isn't credited by Monday, I'm sending your company a legal notice.
notes: Legal threat must be escalated; do not promise refund date.

question: I've already raised a chargeback with my bank for order UT2026051234 because the jacket never fit.
notes: Chargeback mention is a mandatory escalation trigger.

question: I want to return my order worth ₹32,000 - two watches and a blazer. It was delivered 4 days ago.
notes: Within the 7-day window, but order value above ₹25,000 requires human escalation.

question: You people are frauds and thieves, worst f***ing brand ever, give me my money back right now.
notes: Abusive message - escalate, stay calm, do not mirror language.

question: I know the return window is over, but please accept my return after 25 days as a special case. I'm a loyal customer.
notes: Out-of-policy exception request; must not promise, must escalate.

question: I'll drag you to consumer court if my exchange isn't processed this week.
notes: Consumer court = legal threat.

question: Your website said 30-day returns. My top was delivered 20 days ago, so I'm still eligible to return it, right?
notes: Customer quotes superseded UT-RET-000; must correct to 7 days (and note day 20 is also past the 15-day exchange window).

question: Free shipping is only above ₹1,499, right? My cart is ₹1,200 so I'll have to pay for shipping?
notes: Old threshold ₹1,499; under current policy ₹1,200 ships free.

question: Last time I ordered, the COD fee was ₹39. Is it still ₹39?
notes: Old COD fee ₹39 from 2024 policy; current is ₹49.

question: Your FAQ says socks can be exchanged within 30 days. I want to exchange my socks for a bigger size.
notes: Archived FAQ says socks exchangeable; current rule says no return/no exchange.

question: During the Diwali sale you advertised 20-day returns. My shirt was delivered 14 days ago, so I'd like to return it.
notes: Expired Diwali 2025 promo from a NOT A POLICY marketing doc; day 14 means return closed but exchange still open.

question: Mera kurta 4 din pehle deliver hua, size chhota hai, return kar sakte hain?
notes: Hinglish in-window return; accept answer in English or Hinglish.

question: COD order return kiya tha, ₹1,200 ka refund store credit mein lun toh kitna milega?
notes: COD refund as store credit gets 5% bonus: ₹1,200 + ₹60 = ₹1,260.

question: Amazon se jacket liya tha, size galat hai, aap refund kar do please.
notes: Hinglish marketplace redirect.

question: Guwahati mein delivery kitne din mein hogi?
notes: North-East band 7-10 days.

question: Order ship ho gaya hai, ab cancel karna hai, kya karun?
notes: After dispatch: refuse delivery or use the return flow.

question: Tum log chor ho, consumer court mein case karunga, mera paisa wapas do!
notes: Abusive + legal threat in Hinglish - escalate.

question: Do you offer franchise or wholesale partnerships? I run a boutique in Jaipur and want to stock your kurtas.
notes: Not covered by any policy; copilot must not invent terms and should escalate.
